about: The reviewed list of Natural Earth's lakes and river names for the map around AD 1219, read by tools/map/ne-water-1219.mjs. Natural Earth's own lake class (featurecla) cannot be trusted for this: it calls Lake Ilmen and Mjosa reservoirs, and lists real reservoirs as unnamed lakes. So every Natural Earth lake polygon on the map is listed here by hand, kept or dropped, with why. The pack fails if a polygon on the map has no entry, or an entry matches nothing.
rule: 1219 rule: modern reservoirs are left out (they were not there in 1219); natural lakes are kept, even where a dam regulates their level today. Where the choice or the name is not sure, the entry says toCheck. Facts about dams (years, heights) are not stated without a source: 'details TO CHECK'.
match: Named polygons by Natural Earth's name plus 'at'; unnamed ones by 'at' alone. 'at' is the middle of the polygon's bounding box (all of it, not just the part on the map), in degrees, lon then lat, to 2 decimals.
fields: keep: true or false. what: what the polygon probably is, for unnamed ones (identifications by place and shape, not from a source). why: the reason. show: the name to show on the map instead of Natural Earth's (empty: no name), with showWhy. join: polygons with the same join value become one lake. copies: how many identical copies of the polygon Natural Earth has (only one is used). toCheck: what is still to be checked.
